WITH
RECURSIVE neighbours (uuid) AS (
  SELECT
    max(uuid)
  FROM
    messages
  WHERE
    uuid < ?1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    min(uuid)
  FROM
    messages
  WHERE
    uuid > ?1
),
lengths (n) AS (
  SELECT
    8
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    n + 1
  FROM
    lengths
  WHERE
    n < length(?1)
)
SELECT
  substr(?1, 1, coalesce(min(n), length(?1))) AS "prefix!: String"
FROM
  lengths
WHERE
  NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      neighbours
    WHERE
      substr(neighbours.uuid, 1, n) = substr(?1, 1, n)
  )
